title: Unary Rewind Cost
statement: Let $W$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $a,N,j\in\bbn$, and let $last\in\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$. For any input word, base configuration, input-head position, budget-head position and tape, and guide-head position and tape, starting in the unary-rewind phase (unary-reset if $last$ is true and unary-back otherwise) with unary head at $j$ and unary tape containing $N$ markers, after $j+1$ steps the unary head is at $1$ and the phase is start-center if $last$ is true and the first rightward layout phase otherwise; the resulting configuration has all the same data and other head positions.
hypotheses_covered: An input word and base configuration
Integer budget-head position and budget tape
Unary head initially at $j$ and unary tape with $N$ markers
replaced:
For every $j \in \bbn$ and either rewind variant: from a setup configuration in the
corresponding unary rewind phase with unary head at cell $j$ over the unary tape with
$N$ markers, exactly $j+1$ steps reach the successor phase --- the start-center phase
for the final rewind, the first rightward layout phase otherwise --- with unary head at
cell $1$; no tape is written and all other heads are unchanged.
